# mv: move function to a specific file in target package
mv F y.go
-- x.go --
package m

func F() {}
func G() { F() }
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,4 +1,3 @@
 package m

-func F() {}
 func G() { F() }
diff old/y.go new/y.go
--- old/y.go
+++ new/y.go
@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@
+package m
+
+func F() {}
